announcer.ai_generated: Block {{label}}: AI draft ready, requires review.

mode_descriptions.off: Real PII reaches the LLM. Development only.
mode_descriptions.detect_only: Detects PII but does not substitute in the prompt.
mode_descriptions.replace: Substitutes PII with synthetic data before the LLM.
mode_descriptions.replace_with_disposition_7: Replaces with Faker and masks DNI/NIE/Passport (LOPDGDD Disp. 7th).

anonymization.no_run: No analysis has been run yet.
anonymization.mode_locked: Mode cannot be changed while execution is in progress.
anonymization.ner_no_disponible: Name detection in free text was not available for this run: this installation is missing the language model. Deterministic patterns (ID numbers, email, IBAN, phone) and form headers were applied.

autosave.conflict_body: Another session has changed this report. Reload to see the changes; your unsaved ones will be lost.

informe.create_block: How do I create an AI block?
informe.reject_block: What happens if I reject a block?
informe.group_sum: Group by month and sum the amount
informe.bar_chart: Bar chart of total by region

flujo.add_trigger: How do I add a trigger?

copilot.translate_hint: This proposal is a suggestion for you to read: the report blocks are created from the description, in “Propose with AI”.

draft_error.anchored_to_presentation: This passage relies on a table or a chart, and those only draw data. It must rely on the section that produces the data.
draft_error.unknown_reference: This passage relies on a section that does not exist in the proposal.
draft_error.presentation_without_data: This table or chart does not point at any section that produces data.

draft_mode_help_template: Recommended if the report repeats: the template is saved and next time it runs without asking the AI again.
draft_mode_help_workspace: For a report you will only make once.
draft_proposing: Asking the model. This usually takes a few seconds; do not close the screen.

failure.ai_failed: AI could not generate this block. You can retry.
failure.extraction_failed: Data could not be extracted from the document. Check the file and retry.
failure.script_failed: Automatic calculation failed. Contact an administrator.
failure.validation_failed: Data does not meet the expected format.

inputs.drop_here: Drop the file here, or click to choose it
inputs.file_already_uploaded: already uploaded: reused unless you pick another

preview_pending: Before you can see the report, {{count}} AI-written block(s) must be approved. Go back to the report screen and approve them in the review panel.

review.all_approved: All passages approved — ready to assemble
review.regenerate_queued: A rewrite of “{{block}}” was requested. The new text appears the next time the report is generated.
review.source_full: Not anchored: it read the whole report

templates.no_permission: This screen is for administrators only.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Create the first one by describing the report you need.
templates.archive_warning: It will stop appearing in the lists and no new reports can be created from it. Reports already generated from this template are kept and can still be opened and exported. You can bring it back from “Also show retired ones”.

workspace_error: Generation failed. Check the warnings below and try again.
workspace_not_found: This report could not be found.
workspace_pending_approval: The AI-written sections must be approved first

funciones.no_puedes_revisar: You cannot review this version. Review is someone else's job.
funciones.nota_obligatoria: Required: the anchored block will fail and has to say why.
funciones.pide_promover: Promotion assessment. It is the only prior approval in the catalogue.
funciones.pide_solicitar_promocion: Why this function should be available to the whole platform.
funciones.pide_suspender: Reason for the suspension. It travels all the way to the failure of the block that uses it.
funciones.sigue_en_uso: The version keeps running: this is a request to the author, not a stop.
funciones.subtitulo_catalogo: Each function is code with a declared contract. What you can do with each version is decided by the server.
funciones.subtitulo_revision: These versions are already running. Reviewing them does not authorise them: it corrects, reclassifies or stops them.
